meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 该技能会让Claude在触发后系统性地把代码库中的每个源文件从头到尾读一遍；文件太大时就分批读取，直到读完。这样可以完整了解项目代码，方便后续基于它工作。
howto.when: 当开始处理新项目或不熟悉的代码库，或用户说出“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我通读项目里所有源文件，大文件别漏。
帮我快速熟悉这个项目的代码。
say.note: 触发类似“get up to speed”的初始化读取。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude systematically reads every source file in the codebase in full; large files are paged through using offset and limit until all content is read. This builds a complete understanding of the project for later work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting work on a new or unfamiliar codebase, or when the user asks to 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', 'prime', etc.

say_en.text: Read every source file, including large files in chunks.
Help me get up to speed on this project's code.
